name: Integration Last Seen
query:
SELECT
	channel                                                AS "Lane:Data:130",
	source                                                 AS "Integration:Data:260",
	MAX(request_time)                                      AS "Last seen:Datetime:180",
	TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, MAX(request_time), NOW())          AS "Hours quiet:Int:110",
	SUM(request_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR)          AS "Hits 24h:Int:90",
	SUM(request_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY)            AS "Hits 7d:Int:90",
	IF(MAX(request_time) < NOW() - INTERVAL 24 HOUR, 1, 0) AS "Silent:Int:70"
FROM `tabCRM API Request Log`
GROUP BY channel, source
ORDER BY MAX(request_time) ASC
